title: Sports 5 · Badminton, Tennis & Pickleball
description: Từ vựng các môn vợt: cầu lông, tennis, bóng bàn, pickleball (CEFR A2–B2).

cards.question: racket
cards.explanation:
I need to restring my racket.
→ Tôi cần đan lại lưới vợt.

cards.question: shuttlecock
cards.explanation:
The shuttlecock hit the net.
→ Quả cầu chạm lưới.

cards.question: court
cards.explanation:
We booked a badminton court for 8 p.m.
→ Chúng tôi đặt sân cầu lông lúc 8 giờ tối.

cards.question: net
cards.explanation:
The ball clipped the net.
→ Bóng chạm mép lưới.

cards.question: serve
cards.explanation:
It's your turn to serve.
→ Đến lượt bạn giao bóng.

cards.question: return
cards.explanation:
She returned the serve easily.
→ Cô ấy trả giao bóng dễ dàng.

cards.question: rally
cards.explanation:
That was a 30-shot rally!
→ Đó là một loạt đánh 30 lần qua lại!

cards.question: smash
cards.explanation:
His smash is very powerful.
→ Cú đập của anh ấy rất mạnh.

cards.question: drop shot
cards.explanation:
She won the point with a drop shot.
→ Cô ấy ghi điểm bằng cú bỏ nhỏ.

cards.question: forehand
cards.explanation:
My forehand is stronger than my backhand.
→ Cú thuận tay của tôi mạnh hơn trái tay.

cards.question: backhand
cards.explanation:
Practice your backhand more.
→ Tập thêm cú trái tay đi.

cards.question: volley
cards.answer: cú vô-lê (đánh khi bóng chưa chạm đất)
cards.explanation:
He finished the point with a volley at the net.
→ Anh ấy kết thúc điểm bằng cú vô-lê trên lưới.

cards.question: singles
cards.explanation:
Singles is more tiring than doubles.
→ Đánh đơn mệt hơn đánh đôi.

cards.question: doubles
cards.explanation:
Let's play doubles.
→ Chơi đánh đôi nhé.

cards.question: partner
cards.explanation:
My partner covers the back of the court.
→ Đồng đội tôi lo phần cuối sân.

cards.question: point
cards.explanation:
Match point!
→ Điểm quyết định trận!

cards.question: deuce
cards.explanation:
It's deuce again.
→ Lại hoà 40 đều.

cards.question: set
cards.explanation:
She won in straight sets.
→ Cô ấy thắng liền các séc.

cards.question: in
cards.explanation:
Was that in or out?
→ Bóng đó trong hay ngoài?

cards.question: out
cards.explanation:
The ball was clearly out.
→ Bóng rõ ràng ra ngoài.

cards.question: fault
cards.explanation:
That's a fault — your foot was on the line.
→ Lỗi rồi — chân bạn giẫm vạch.

cards.question: grip
cards.explanation:
Change your grip for the backhand.
→ Đổi cách cầm vợt khi đánh trái tay.

cards.question: footwork
cards.explanation:
Good footwork is the key to badminton.
→ Bộ chân tốt là chìa khoá của cầu lông.

cards.question: table tennis
cards.explanation:
We have a table tennis table at the office.
→ Văn phòng có bàn bóng bàn.

cards.question: pickleball
cards.explanation:
Pickleball is very popular in Vietnam now.
→ Pickleball hiện rất thịnh hành ở Việt Nam.

cards.question: paddle
cards.explanation:
Pickleball paddles are solid, not strung.
→ Vợt pickleball đặc, không có lưới.

cards.question: opponent
cards.explanation:
My opponent was much younger.
→ Đối thủ trẻ hơn tôi nhiều.

cards.question: tiebreak
cards.explanation:
The set went to a tiebreak.
→ Séc đấu phải phân định bằng tie-break.

cards.question: champion
cards.explanation:
He's the national badminton champion.
→ Anh ấy là nhà vô địch cầu lông quốc gia.

cards.question: amateur
cards.explanation:
It's just an amateur tournament.
→ Đó chỉ là giải nghiệp dư.

cards.question: spin
cards.explanation:
Put more spin on the ball.
→ Tạo thêm độ xoáy cho bóng.

cards.question: the ball is in your court
cards.explanation:
I've sent the proposal; the ball is in your court.
→ Tôi đã gửi đề xuất; giờ đến lượt bạn quyết.
